diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), Not Otherwise Specified (NOS), non-germinal center B-cell (non-GCB / ABC) subtype.
stage: Ann Arbor Stage III (or Stage IIIS, designating splenic involvement), supported by FDG-avid lymphadenopathy on both sides of the diaphragm (left axillary, mediastinal, mesenteric, and para-aortic) and splenic nodules, with negative bone marrow biopsy.
biology: Double-expressor lymphoma (DEL). Immunohistochemistry demonstrates overexpression of BCL2 (70%, threshold >=50%) and MYC (45%, threshold >=40%). FISH testing confirms absence of MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 gene rearrangements, ruling out high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2/BCL6 rearrangements ('double-hit' or 'triple-hit' lymphoma).
prognosis: International Prognostic Index (IPI) score of 2, categorizing the patient as Low-Intermediate risk. Scoring rationale: Age 59 (0 pts, since <=60), Ann Arbor Stage III (1 pt), elevated LDH of 510 U/L (1 pt), ECOG performance status 1 (0 pts, since <=1), and single extraneodal site / spleen involvement (0 pts, since <=1 extraneodal site).
first_line_treatment: R-CHOP (Rituximab, Cyclophosphamide, Doxorubicin, Vincristine, Prednisone) for 6 cycles, or Polatuzumab vedotin-R-CHP (Pola-R-CHP) for 6 cycles based on the POLARIX trial demonstrating improved progression-free survival in intermediate-to-high risk DLBCL.
cns_risk: CNS-IPI score of 2 (Intermediate risk), derived from elevated LDH and advanced Ann Arbor stage (Stage III). Routine CNS prophylaxis (e.g., intrathecal or systemic methotrexate) is generally not recommended for intermediate-risk CNS-IPI in the absence of high-risk anatomical involvement (such as testicular, renal, adrenal, breast, or epidural disease), though risk-benefit discussion and surveillance remain standard.
response_assessment: 18F-FDG PET-CT scan after completion of all planned therapy cycles (and optionally interim PET after 4 cycles), interpreted using Lugano 2014 criteria and the Deauville 5-Point Scale, where a score of 1-3 indicates Complete Metabolic Response (CMR).
missing_information: Baseline cardiac function evaluation (LVEF via echocardiogram or MUGA) for anthracycline safety, comprehensive metabolic panel (creatinine clearance, liver function tests), and viral hepatitis/HIV serologies (HBsAg, HBcAb, HCV Ab, HIV) prior to initiating chemoimmunotherapy.
